Direct sync invocation of check_ape_scadenza() works.

rca of the issue: TipoNotifica Pydantic enum was hardcoded to 5 values. New check_ape_scadenza task introduced 2 new tipo strings ('ape_scadenza', 'ape_scaduto') but enum was not updated. After even a single ape_scaduto notification was inserted into MongoDB by the task, the GET /notifiche endpoint failed validating the response model, returning 500. Reproduction: trigger check_ape_scadenza when an expired APE exists, then GET /api/v1/notifiche -> 500. Mitigation: add APE_SCADENZA, APE_SCADUTO to TipoNotifica enum (done).
